response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer (14+ years) with deep TypeScript/Node.js expertise, current AI-agent infrastructure work (MCP frameworks) at re:cinq, and broad exposure to relational/NoSQL databases, Docker/Kubernetes, and multiple programming languages. His resume doesn't explicitly mention Nest.js, React, or Vitest, or formal testing framework experience, but his craftsmanship background (TDD, custom test runners) and rapid learning curve across many stacks suggest he could ramp up quickly.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across 15+ years and diverse tech stacks
Current hands-on experience with AI-agent development and MCP frameworks, directly matching a required skill
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing tools authorship) signaling high code quality standards
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or React, both core to the primary stack
No direct mention of Vitest/Jest/Playwright testing frameworks despite testing-focused background
Frequent job changes historically (though recent tenures are longer) could raise retention questions

key_factors.factor: Broad seniority and full-stack architecture experience
